note: The document describes ECMS as the Attorney General's Office legal-affairs case system (file registration, calendars, case data); it does not say courts manage their cases on it.
The document states nothing this study asks for Seychelles.

facts.fact: The Seychelles Judiciary launched its e-Service Platform, phase one, letting legal practitioners file written submissions and upload documents online, with card payment and digital receipts; built by vendor Switch.

Chief Justice Govinden's Electronic Filing of Written Submissions (Civil Matters) Rules, 2025 (S.I. 72) let legal practitioners and parties file written submissions in civil cases before the Supreme Court electronically via a designated online platform or the Court's email address; commencement date is left blank in the gazetted text.
facts.system: Supreme Court electronic filing of written submissions
